title: Return verbatim knowledge excerpts
subtitle: Use query generation, Custom Search and an AI Prompt to return exact text with citations.

steps.title: Rewrite the user query with context
steps.evidence: It rewrites a user query with relevant conversation context before sending it to an AI Prompt.

steps.title: Run Custom Search on knowledge
steps.evidence: Use Custom Search with an AI Prompt that receives the search results and instructs the agent to quote them verbatim without summarizing.

steps.title: Quote results verbatim with citations
steps.evidence: The flow can also include citations.
